name: RSSHub
description: RSSHub generates RSS feeds for sites that do not offer them - social networks, video platforms, shops, forums, news outlets and hundreds more, through community-maintained route definitions. Feed the resulting URLs into any reader such as FreshRSS, Miniflux or CommaFeed.

notes.text: The instance is open to anyone who can reach it. Before exposing it, uncomment ACCESS_KEY in /opt/rsshub.env, restart rsshub and add ?key=... to your feed URLs, or strangers can use it to scrape other sites.
Routes that need credentials (some social networks) take extra variables in /opt/rsshub.env; see the upstream route documentation.
